goal: Prove one exact-rig Quaternius skinned outfit with coarse body replacement and no cloth, gameplay-body or network complexity.

confirmed.important_conclusion: SKINNED_GARMENT pose composition and generic ref-counted hide/restore are proven. The remaining real-asset question is how to preserve the head while hiding the Standard-pack FullBody geometry.

windows_current_standard_refresh.archive: Universal Base Characters[Standard].zip downloaded from the current public download flow
windows_current_standard_refresh.false_positive_in_previous_zip_preflight: Paths under 'Hairstyles/Rigged to Head Bone' were incorrectly counted as Head/Upperbody character variants because the matcher inspected the full archive path instead of the leaf model filename.
windows_current_standard_refresh.powershell_diagnostic_bug: Invoke-VariantProbe emitted native stdout to the success pipeline, so assigning its return value captured the whole Godot log plus the numeric exit code instead of only the exit code.
windows_current_standard_refresh.important_correction: Do not classify the user's local archive as merely stale. The newly downloaded Standard archive itself was observed without standalone Head/Upperbody glTF character variants.

import_noise_after_refresh.followup: Refresh tooling should run the existing Quaternius asset preflight before editor import.

next_probe.purpose: Print the real FullBody scene tree, every MeshInstance3D, surface/material name and AABB so CH7.8 can decide whether body-only hiding is possible while keeping head/eyes/hair from the same already-animated base scene.
next_probe.preferred_if_supported: Hide only body geometry in the existing FullBody scene; keep its Skeleton3D and head-related geometry alive; do not instantiate a second head skeleton.
next_probe.fallback_if_head_is_fused_into_body_surf: Choose the smallest surface-level presentation solution only after inspecting real mesh/material structure; do not add generic retargeting, mesh surgery or gameplay changes speculatively.
